meta.title: Bank Card BIN Lookup - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Enter the first 6–8 digits of any bank card to look up the issuing bank, country, card type, and brand.
binLookupHint: Enter the first 6-8 digits of a card number (BIN/IIN) to look up issuer info.
steps_bank-bin_1Desc: Type the first 6-8 digits of a credit or debit card (the Bank Identification Number). BINs identify the issuing bank, card brand, and card type.
steps_bank-bin_2Desc: Click Look Up to retrieve the card issuer, brand (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), card type (credit/debit/prepaid), and issuing country.
steps_bank-bin_3Desc: Click any field to copy it. Useful for payment processing verification, fraud detection, and understanding card payment infrastructure.
desc: Enter the first 6–8 digits of any bank card to look up the issuing bank, country, card type, and brand.
ui.100: Data source: built-in compact static table (common brand rules + major domestic issuing bank BINs), not an authoritative full database; results are for reference only.
